sources.hardware_scale: Qwen3-4B example uses 8x80GB A800; full reported setup lists 128 training plus 16 inference A100/A800 80GB GPUs.

sources.hardware_scale: Minimum 8x80GB GPUs per agent; MARTI-v2 reports 3 nodes of 8 H200 GPUs.

sources.original_task_scope: Width/depth controller synthesis for mathematical-reasoning trajectories.

known_failure_modes: outdated facts are hard to update
in-context teacher quality bounds the student

sources.hardware_scale: CUDA-first Trinity-RFT/vLLM training on ALFWorld, WebShop and ScienceWorld.
known_failure_modes: curriculum direction is environment-dependent

sources.local_transfer: Directly adopt bounded short-to-long scheduling logic and compare both directions against flat OPD.

sources.original_task_scope: Temporal curriculum for long multi-turn agent distillation.
sources.title: TCOD: Exploring Temporal Curriculum in On-Policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents

sources.hardware_scale: Single node of 8xH200 for default 7B-8B settings.
known_failure_modes: empirical confidence needs enough verified rollouts
task accuracy can improve while calibration degrades
sources.local_transfer: Use empirical task success and Brier/ECE gates for all teacher-generated confidence claims.

sources.hardware_scale: Multi-GPU on-policy rollout/logit training; exact paper accelerator count not asserted by this registry.
known_failure_modes: late-stage collapse and response drift are reported
feedback leakage can reward formatting artifacts
sources.local_transfer: Ablate against GRPO with drift, OOD, formatting and long-horizon stability gates.
sources.mechanism: A feedback-conditioned self-teacher turns rich verifier text into token-level supervision.
sources.original_task_scope: Dense token-level learning from rich environment feedback in code and reasoning.
sources.title: Reinforcement Learning via Self-Distillation

sources.hardware_scale: CUDA-first Wan 1.3B/14B distillation with multi-GPU context parallelism.
known_failure_modes: joint sCM and DMD training can be unstable

sources.local_transfer: Reuse evaluation and staged-training concepts; full training remains outside the single-card budget.
sources.mechanism: Score regularization stabilizes continuous-time consistency training; staged dCM-to-sCM-to-DMD is recommended.
sources.original_task_scope: Few-step video diffusion distillation and causal/autoregressive extension.
sources.title: rCM: Score-Regularized Continuous-Time Consistency Model

sources.hardware_scale: CUDA-first autoregressive video training over Wan-style checkpoints and curated latent data.
known_failure_modes: base model is limited to roughly five seconds/81 frames
long-video comparisons are invalid without a matched extension
sources.local_transfer: Adopt causal evaluation and matched-horizon comparison; do not claim long-video or Radeon parity.
sources.mechanism: Causal ODE or consistency initialization bridges teacher forcing and self forcing.
sources.original_task_scope: Few-step real-time interactive autoregressive video generation.
sources.title: Causal Forcing: Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation Done Right

sources.hardware_scale: High-resolution CUDA-first one-step restoration; memory depends on tiled output resolution.
known_failure_modes: restoration can hallucinate brand details

sources.local_transfer: Directly reuse tiled workflow and identity/claim retention checks around the released restorer.

sources.original_task_scope: One-step real-world high-resolution video restoration.
sources.title: SeedVR2: One-Step Video Restoration via Diffusion Adversarial Post-Training
